build_pisa_ssd_head: build a PISASSDHead instance configured with num_classes, in_channels, and anchor_generator for object detection
compute_loss_by_feat: compute classification and regression losses for PISA SSD head using cls_scores and bbox_preds
apply_isr_p: apply ISR-P label reweighting to refine positive and negative sample targets during training
compute_carl_loss: compute CARL consistency-aware ranking loss to improve classification-regression consistency in PISA SSD
review_pisa_ssd_head: review the PISASSDHead class and its loss_by_feat method for PISA SSD object detection training
